brief:
The ongoing conflict in Gaza has devastated animal populations and agricultural infrastructure, the Palestine News Network reported. Farms and beekeeping facilities have suffered widespread destruction, while shortages of medicines, vaccines, and animal feed have compounded losses across the territory's livestock sector.

The *Aalamakshouf* programme examined the environmental and agricultural toll of the war, documenting how animals and wildlife have been affected by the destruction and resource scarcity gripping Gaza.
dek: Bethlehem / PNN — A new episode of *Aalamakshouf* examined the impact of the war on animals, livestock and the environment in the Gaza Strip, amid widespread destruction of farms and beekeeping facilities, shortages of medicines, vaccines and animal feed, and…
title: Gaza war decimates livestock, bees, and wildlife, report finds
